agyos_skill.intent: Strategies and patterns for optimizing cloud costs across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
agyos_skill.instructions: Strategies and patterns for optimizing cloud costs across AWS, Azure, and GCP. - The task is unrelated to cloud cost optimization - You need a different domain or tool outside this scope - Clarify goals, constraints, and required inputs. - Apply relevant best practices and validate outcomes. - Provide actionable steps and verification. - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. Implement systematic cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spending while maintaining performance and reliability. - Reduce cloud spending - Right-size resources - Implement cost governance - Optimize multi-cloud costs - Meet budget constraints - Implement cost allocation tags - Use cloud cost management tools - Set up budget alerts - Create cost dashboards - Analyze resource utilization - Downsize over-provisioned resources - Use auto-scaling - Remove idle resources - Use reserved capacity - Leverage spot/preemptible instances - Implement savings plans - Use committed use discounts
